topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The beast's breath is on the back of my neck, and I pray to Saint Francis for guidance. The old house on the hill, with its creaking doors and whispering walls, now stands in the hands of my girl and her brother. I've seen it with my own eyes, the way the land can turn on those who don't know its ways. They talk of changes, of bringing in the new, but I can only think of the harvests I've seen fail, the seasons that turned bitter without warning. I hope they remember the old ways, the respect for the soil and the sky. May the saints watch over them, for the land is unforgiving to those who don't understand its heart.
